squash_pumpkin.reason: Seven lengthy variety rows create 31 mm page-one overflow in both units. Four examples fit; summer/winter/pumpkin distinctions remain in introduction, planting and harvest, with all nine problems retained.

looking_after_the_crop.text: Protect shoots from frost. Earth up or mulch before tubers are exposed; weed carefully and water as tubers swell, especially in pots.
If blight becomes established, remove affected haulm and debris. Where conditions permit, wait about two weeks before lifting; use sound tubers promptly.

harvesting.text: Test-lift earlies at a useful size and use fresh. Lift storage crops after haulm dies, before severe frost, forking carefully and collecting every tuber.
Dry briefly out of strong light. Store only sound, dry tubers in breathable sacks, cool, dark and frost-free; use sound damaged ones first and discard rot.
